subject: COBOL-WORDS directive
notes: SR5 'The same COBOL word shall not be contained in a literal in more than one COBOL-WORDS directive within a single compilation group' (cite.py OK §7.3.10.3 5)). seenWords (OrdinalIgnoreCase) spans both operands of every directive in the group. Probed: EQUATE "DISPLAY" ... + EQUATE "display" ... -> 1623 (case-insensitive); RESERVE "ZQX" + RESERVE "zqx" -> 1623; the unit test covers the cross-option (RESERVE then EQUATE literal-2) case. A POP withdrawing ops does not withdraw seenWords, consistent with SR5's group-wide scope. || editions (adjudicator): 2023 only (new in COBOL-2023: Foreword list 'Additional compiler directives were added: COBOL-WORDS directive'; Annex E.3.3 item 12, cite.py OK §E.3.3 12)); below 2023 the directive word is COBOL0900
